# bloxone_cdc_destination_applications (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Application Destinations.

The Application Destination object sends Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data to an application (automation script).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC Application Destinations filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_applications" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_destination_application"
  }
}

# Get CDC Application Destinations filtered by tag
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_applications" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC Application Destinations
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_applications" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The list of Application Destinations matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `application` (Number) The identifier of the application (automation script) that receives the data.
- `name` (String) The name of the application destination.

Optional:

- `context` (Map of String) The variables passed to the application.
- `description` (String) The description of the application destination.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the application destination is enabled. Defaults to _false_.
- `output_data_format` (String) The output data format of the application destination. Defaults to _STREAM_.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the application destination.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the application destination, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
